title: Unlimited Plan Upgrades and Downgrades — Advisor Training Notes
content:
### Training notes: plan changes on Marlowe & Finch Unlimited

**The rule.** A move to a higher-ranked Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan takes effect at once: the member pays the new plan's fee less the unused value of the current period, the unused value being the current fee multiplied by the remaining days of the period and divided by its days, and a new period starts that day. A move to a lower-ranked plan takes effect at the next renewal, without refund. At most 1 plan change is made per billing period. A plan change is made only while the membership is in status active. Moving to the student plan needs a current student verification.

**Plan ranks** (1 lowest, 6 highest): Unlimited Standard Monthly 1, Unlimited Student Annual 2, Unlimited Standard Annual 3, Unlimited Express Monthly 4, Unlimited Express Annual 5, Unlimited Next-Day Annual 6.

**Q. Which statuses allow a plan change?**
A. Only active, as the membership record shows it. A membership in status trial, past due, cancellation pending or expired is not changed.

| Status on the record | Plan change made |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes, within the limit of 1 per billing period |
| Trial, past due, cancellation pending, expired | No |

**Q. What does the member pay on an upgrade?**
A. The new plan's fee less the unused value of the current period. A new period starts on the day of the change, and the charge appears on the membership ledger as an upgrade proration charge.

**Q. What happens on a downgrade?**
A. Nothing is refunded. The membership record shows the lower-ranked plan as the plan scheduled for the next renewal, and the move takes effect at that renewal.

**Q. Can a member move to Unlimited Student Annual?**
A. Only with a current student verification.

**Worked upgrade (hypothetical period and dates).** A member on Unlimited Express Monthly (rank 4, fee 9.99) moves to Unlimited Next-Day Annual (rank 6, fee 99.00) with 10 of the current period's 30 days remaining. The unused value is 9.99 multiplied by 10 and divided by 30, which is 3.33. The member pays 99.00 less 3.33, which is 95.67, and a new Unlimited Next-Day Annual period starts that day.

**Worked downgrade (hypothetical).** A member on Unlimited Next-Day Annual (rank 6) asks to move to Unlimited Express Annual (rank 5). The move is a downgrade: it is scheduled for the next renewal and refunds nothing of the current period.
